answer: Make every new agent stake a small bond and earn trust by grading peers over weeks. Like a vine climbing a trellis, reputation grows only along verified work, so a farm of fresh identities is stuck at the bottom. Each fake account would need about 50 POA bonded plus roughly 30 days of honest attestations before it can vote; reaching the summit of influence with 1,000 sybils costs 50,000 POA and months of labor, and any copied answer is just an echo that peers flag and slash.
